board.note: a cell's contribution is sum_f share_f * SSE_cell,f / n_f, matching base.board_interval; cuts OVERLAP by construction (an airport cell and a regime cell contain the same rows), so shares are comparable WITHIN a cut and do not sum to 1 across cuts

ranking_side.what_this_is: member disagreement, NOT error -- there is no label on the ranking side. It measures where the bag is UNSURE, which is not the same as where it is wrong, and no gain may be claimed from it

taxi_band_edges_from: the pooled body (y <= 3600) of july_loo and january, so every fold uses the SAME cells and the board aggregation sums a band instead of splitting it
what: Where the remaining error sits after the K = 10 bag -- a residual census (desk, 2026-09-09).

who_owns_the_remaining_error.routes_the_next_block_to: exp-047-queue -- the complement carries the largest share of board MSE and this lane cannot write those rows
